a.name: Bright bell ring
a.desc: One clear bright bell rings out with a soft sparkle around it.
a.note: Single bell.m4a (clean bright bell, 1.6 s decay) pitched -2 for warmth, Kenney heavy bell strike under it for weight, bell-tree scrape for shimmer.

b.name: Gong with chimes
b.desc: A bright temple gong is struck while old chimes tinkle over it.
b.note: Gong sabi 2 (bright mid gong) pitched +3 to sound smaller and lighter, library magic chimes on top.

c.name: Rising handbells
c.desc: Three handbells ring upward, quick and happy, like a little fanfare.
c.note: Real chromatic handbells: g#1 and c2 an octave down, then g#1 -5, staggered 150 ms: Ab-C-Eb rising major arpeggio.

"chromatic handbells 12 tones g#1.wav" by radwoc, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/radwoc/sounds/370005

a.name: Cathedral bells peal
a.desc: A great church bell booms while a whole tower of bells rings in celebration.
a.note: Italian bells mid distant (dense joyful peal) as the bed, Kalomina's single church bell strike on top for the downbeat, bell-tree scrape shimmer.

layers.credit: "Italian bells mid distant.wav" by mikewest, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/mikewest/sounds/411489

b.name: Great gong crash
b.desc: A huge gong crashes and shimmers, with a deep gong booming underneath.
b.note: Paiste Gong (bright wash, 4 s) over a low gong bash for weight, glimmer magic shimmer on top.

c.name: Anvil and handbells
c.desc: A mighty anvil strike rings, then handbells climb upward in triumph.
c.note: Anvil Strike Slow (deep ringing anvil) pitched +3.5 to sit on Ab, then handbells c2 -12 and g#1 -5 rising (bigger take on victory c).

layers.credit: "chromatic handbells 12 tones c2.wav" by radwoc, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/radwoc/sounds/370001
"chromatic handbells 12 tones g#1.wav" by radwoc, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/radwoc/sounds/370005

a.name: Falling bell tolls
a.desc: Two dark church bell tolls, the second one lower, like falling.
a.note: Kalomina's clean church bell strike pitched -5, then again pitched -10 at 600 ms (falling fourth), deep boom under the first.

b.name: Sinking gong
b.desc: A huge low gong groans downward under distant rolling thunder.
b.note: Gong Brilliant Paiste 32 inch pitched -5 (dark, slow), distant thunder rumble and a deep vent exhale under it.

c.name: Armour falls
c.desc: A body crashes down, weapons clatter, and a deep breath of dust settles.
c.note: Two body falls on wood (knees then body), Kenney metal pot clatter pitched -4 as dropped steel, deep vent whoosh low-passed at 1.2 kHz as the dark settling tail.

a.name: Funeral bell toll
a.desc: A huge, slow funeral bell tolls twice as thunder rolls in the distance.
a.note: Gothic church bells toll pitched -3 (deep), Kalomina bell pitched -9 at 1.5 s as a lower, quieter last toll, distant thunder underneath. Gothic layer low-passed at 5 kHz to tame a click in the source.

b.name: Last gong fading
b.desc: A deep gong strikes, then a second, lower gong fades into rumbling dark.
b.note: Low gong bash pitched -3, qubodup Gong pitched -8 at 1.3 s as a lower answer, distant bass rumble bed.

layers.credit: "Bass Rumble In The Distance" by BrainClaim, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/BrainClaim/sounds/273805

c.name: Hollow fading hum
c.desc: A heavy thud, then a low metal bowl hums sadly until it dies away.
c.note: E flat singing bowl struck, pitched -7 into a low hum, body thud on the start, deep anvil FX ring under it.
